entity: Atlantic City Housing Authority (ACHA) public housing vacancies
what_we_add: 339 regular vacancies of 1,473 units; highest of 91 similar non-Moving-to-Work authorities, 5.9x their 3.9% median; almost half at Stanley Holmes Village, 50% occupied
why: CBS Philadelphia (Jul 2025) reports HUD found ACHA only 71.4% occupied against a 96% goal, the same finding in the same month's HUD data. That is 28.6% empty vs our 23% 'regular' vacancies: a different definition, and within 25%. No source has the peer ranking, the 5.9x or the Stanley Holmes split. NJ Globe is an op-ed; the Press headlines don't state the finding.
